title: INSIDE the Student's Mind: Jointly Modeling Latent Reasoning and Action in LLM Student Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2608.10492v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based simulators often reproduce observable actions but fail to capture the underlying reasoning behind them. In education, where student simulation is increasingly used for various applications such as evaluating tutoring systems, this gap is especially pronounced. Two students may submit identical submissions for entirely different reasons. We present INTERNAL STUDENT DIALOGUE (INSIDE), a student modeling framework that fine-tunes LLMs not only to act like students but also to think like them. INSIDE generates internal dialogue grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy across cognitive, affective, and action dimensions, and fine-tunes models on paired think traces and actions. We baseline against different prompting frameworks and evaluate on two axes: fidelity of simulated actions and quality of generated internal dialogue. translated_title: 学生思维内部：联合建模LLM学生模拟器中的潜在推理与行为
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的模拟器通常能复现可观察的行为，但无法捕捉其背后的推理过程。在教育领域，学生模拟越来越多地用于评估辅导系统等应用，这一缺陷尤为突出。两名学生可能因完全不同的原因提交相同的答案。我们提出了“内部学生对话”（INSIDE）框架，该框架微调LLM，不仅使其行为像学生，还使其思考方式像学生。INSIDE基于布鲁姆分类法，在认知、情感和行为维度生成内部对话，并在成对的思考轨迹和行为上微调模型。我们以不同提示框架为基线，并从两个维度评估：模拟行为的保真度和生成内部对话的质量。评估表明，INSIDE在行为保真度上提升了模拟的准确性，且在匹配行为方面表现更佳。
tldr: 本文提出INSIDE框架，通过基于布鲁姆分类法生成内部对话并微调LLM，同时建模学生的潜在推理和行为，显著提升了学生模拟的行为保真度和推理质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the INSIDE framework, which jointly models latent reasoning and actions in LLM student simulators by generating Bloom's Taxonomy-grounded internal dialogue and fine-tuning, improving both action fidelity and reasoning quality.
